description: Consumer home internet offers (fixed broadband alone or with TV, landline or mobile) in these markets: Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, France, United Kingdom, Italy, Spain, Romania, Slovenia, Malta, Cyprus, Estonia, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Latvia, Austria, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Iceland, Liechtenstein, United States, Bulgaria, Czechia, Denmark, Finland, Greece, Ireland, Lithuania, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Sweden, Canada. Returns the offers that meet the stated speed, region, TV / landline and contract needs, ranked by average monthly cost over the horizon (promos for their stated months, one-off fees, modem rental, and bundle discounts when the household has that operator's mobile), each part shown, with the source link, check date and the operator's address-check link. List prices are national; availability depends on the address.

accept_contract.description: false = only offers without a minimum term.

autopay.description: US: false = the household won't use AutoPay / paperless billing; advertised AutoPay discounts are added back. Default true.

data_gb_month.description: Monthly data use in GB; plans with a lower data cap don't fit (most US fixed plans state unlimited data).

download_mbps_min.description: Minimum advertised download speed in Mbps.

has_mobile_with.description: Operator or group the household has mobile with (e.g. Telenet, Proximus, KPN); counts that operator's bundle discounts.

horizon_months.description: Months to average costs over. Default 24.

max_monthly.description: Budget per month in the market's currency, averaged over the horizon.

max_term_months.description: Longest minimum term accepted, in months.

region.description: Province, state or region (e.g. Wallonia, Friesland, Texas). Regional operators are matched on it.

special_eligibility.description: True if the household qualifies for social tariffs or other restricted offers.

technology.description: Only offers sold on this technology.

unlimited_data.description: True = only plans without a data cap.

upload_mbps_min.description: Minimum advertised upload speed in Mbps.

wants_mobile.description: True if offers that include mobile lines may be shown.

wants_mobile_with.description: Operator the household would take mobile from as well; counts that operator's bundle discounts.

name: compare_home_internet
title: Compare home internet
